title: The Steady-State Approximation
description: An enzyme's middle step is made as fast as it is used up: set its rate of change to zero, and the algebra falls out.

puzzle.goal: An enzyme catches its substrate at a rate a, lets it go at b and turns it over at c. Write the substrate level K at which it runs at half speed.
puzzle.name: Michaelis constant
puzzle.ask: Find K for a = @{a}, b = 3 and c = 1.
puzzle.method: The bound enzyme is made at a·E·S and lost at (b + c)·ES; holding it steady gives K = (b + c)/a.
